svg.aria-label: Shared memory alignment: on main a shared array's PTX alignment came from the programmer's request alone or from an exporter guess, never from the element type, and nobody checked the request; a u64 array at ALIGN 1 and a repr(C, align(16)) struct at natural alignment faulted with CUDA error 716 when ptxas packed them behind a smaller array, and ALIGN 3 died in llc. After PR 1345 the MIR verifier rejects an alignment that is not a non-zero power of two at the use site, and mir-lower declares every static array and the dynamic pool at the larger of the request and the element's ABI alignment, computed by required_storage_align from the Rust ABI raise and the LLVM natural layout

text.style: font: 600 17px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: Shared memory alignment: the request is checked, storage is declared at max(ALIGN, abi_align(T))

text.style: font: 400 12.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: Before, a shared array's PTX .align came from the request alone or from an exporter guess (8 for every aggregate); the element type's own alignment never entered, and nobody checked the request.

svg.text: Why main declared too little, and why it faulted

text.style: font: 400 10.8px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: ALIGN > 0 reached the global unchecked. ALIGN 0 left the global with no alignment, and the exporter guessed one:

text.style: font: 400 10.8px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: the integer width in bytes, 4 for f32, 8 for every other element, and 0 for bool (which llc rejected).

text.style: font: 400 10.8px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: The element type's ABI alignment never entered, so the declared .align could be weaker than the kernel's own stores.

text.style: font: 400 10.8px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: Shared globals are inserted at the module front, so the first array a kernel touches lands last in the PTX, right

text.style: font: 400 10.8px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: behind the pad. ptxas packed DATA and VS at offsets their st.shared.b64 and st.shared.v4.b32 could not use, and

text.style: font: 400 10.8px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: the launch failed with CUDA error 716, misaligned address (reproduced on sm_120a for three kernels).

text.style: font: 600 12px var(--sans); fill: var(--rust); white-space: pre

svg.text: Where the alignment comes from now (mir-lower)

svg.text: ALIGN is 0 (natural) or a non-zero power of two for SharedArray, and a non-zero power of two for DynamicSharedArray; anything else is a compile error that names the use site.

text.style: font: 400 11.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: Storage is never declared below align_of::<T>(): a smaller request is raised silently, a larger one is honored. The dynamic pool takes its strongest typed use plus the launch contract.
